answer: Full reward requires answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 57%. Because the raven pair is tracked in the ember ledger, the echo audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 101 identities means 101 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
